name: hud_ui_main_menu_load_button_on_activate
description: HudUiMainMenuDialog_LoadButton::OnActivate opens the load dialog in standard mode from the frontend, fade mode from in-game, and then performs normal ZRD widget activation behavior.
known_limits: tier S verification is deferred; no VC target currently covers 0x415140.
functional_evidence: Binary Ninja assembly for 0x415140 validates reading g_RecoilState_MainMenuTransition.m_entryRoute, passing mode 0 for frontend and mode 1 for non-frontend, then calling HudUiZrdWidget::OnActivate.

Native smoke hud_ui_main_menu_load_button_on_activate_smoke dispatches the constructed Load button activation slot in frontend and in-game routes, verifies queued pushes of g_RecoilStateSaveLoadTransition with parameter 0, verifies standard/fade transition modes and load dialog kind, verifies one OnEnter callback for each route, and verifies base activation image updates.
